title: GADC data construction pipeline (Gugak Acoustic Descriptor Corpus)
description: Documentation, data dictionaries, romanization glossary, domain mapping rules, validation summaries and the cleaned Jupyter notebook for rule-based metadata construction, acoustic feature extraction, feature-metadata merging, acoustic orientation profiling and technical validation of the Gugak Acoustic Descriptor Corpus (GADC). Audio segmentation is not part of the notebook; it followed the rule described in the associated Data Descriptor. The data package is archived separately on Zenodo (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19964646).
